commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Someone who wants the righteousness of compassion and stands in household life, the path to it, is ruined by merely thinking of wrongful ways to get others’ wealth. Only household life ripens the understanding needed to renounce. Ruin is losing both kinds of righteousness. If thinking ruins, doing needs no saying.
